description.narrative: The project#s aim is to bring holistic industrial water management practices to Maghreb and MENA regions. It will do so through three distinct channels: First, a curriculum will be developed on #Aquatronics#, a new and innovative educational concept that combines different professions and specializations related to water and wastewater for civil and industrial (incl. agro-industrial) applications. The curricula will have two audiences: secondary school students and vocational training students with an aim to reach beHaviour change on the importance of water and understanding of the holistic nature or water. Second, two (2) hubs will be established in order to i) teach and ii) demonstrate water-smart technologies. Aquatronics curricula will be taught at a skills training hub for students at the vocational level. Latest technology will be showcased at a technology demonstration hub, where the private sector will expose the state-of-the-art expertise in the field of water resources management. More specifically, the technology will be presented in the fields of water productivity, water efficiency and water capture and storage. Third, the Outreach and advocacy component will have two distinctive aims: i) to connect students with employers through career centers and ii) to replicate the model project H2O Maghreb
